name: Zentria Flow for WooCommerce
author: orhansavash

sections.description:
Zentria Flow is a tariff intelligence platform that automatically calculates the true landed cost of every imported product — customs duty, VAT, Section 301, Section 122 surcharge, and all fees — for 130+ countries.

Connect your WooCommerce store in 60 seconds and get:

  • Automatic landed cost on every new order — duty + VAT + freight + insurance
  • AI-powered HS code lookup — classify products by name or description
  • Section 122 + Section 301 stacking — critical for China→US imports (flat 10% Section 122 surcharge + Section 301 rates calculated automatically)
  • Live tariff alerts — Federal Register monitoring, USTR updates delivered to your inbox
  • 55+ FTA checks — USMCA, CPTPP, and more — zero-duty detection for qualifying goods
  • Order admin meta box — see landed cost directly in your WooCommerce order view
  • Landed cost column in the orders list

Why it matters now: The Section 122 flat 10% import surcharge expires July 24, 2026 unless Congress extends it. Importers building Q3 pricing need to model both scenarios — surcharge renewed vs. lapsed — across every SKU. Zentria Flow calculates all tariff layers automatically so you never underestimate your landed cost.

Countries supported

United States, United Kingdom, European Union (27 members), Turkey, Canada, Mexico, Japan, South Korea, Vietnam, India, Indonesia, Thailand, Taiwan, and 50+ more economies.

How it works

  1. Install the plugin and click Connect to Zentria Flow
  2. Authorize read/write access on the WooCommerce OAuth screen
  3. Start your 7-day free trial
  4. Landed cost appears automatically on every new order

Privacy

This plugin sends your WooCommerce order data (product name, SKU, quantity, value, shipping destination) to api.zentriaflow.com to calculate landed cost. No personally identifiable customer data (name, address, email) is transmitted. See our Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zentria-flow-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Zentria Flow
  4. Click Connect to Zentria Flow and complete the authorization
  5. Choose your plan (7-day free trial available)
sections.faq:
Do I need a Zentria Flow account?

The plugin creates your account automatically during the connect flow. No pre-registration required.

Is there a free trial?

Yes — every new store gets a 7-day free trial. You can install and connect the plugin without a card; a card is required to start the trial, and you won’t be charged until day 8. Cancel anytime before then and you won’t be billed.

Which countries are covered?

70+ countries. Full list at zentriaflow.com/customs-duty-calculator.

Does it handle Section 301 and Section 122 tariffs for China?

Yes. Zentria Flow automatically stacks MFN + Section 301 + the current Section 122 flat surcharge (10%) for China→US shipments. The Section 122 surcharge is in effect until July 24, 2026 — Zentria Flow models both scenarios (extended vs. lapsed) so you can plan pricing accurately.

What WooCommerce version is required?

WooCommerce 6.0 or higher. The plugin supports both classic orders and the new High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I disconnect at any time?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce → Zentria Flow → Disconnect. This immediately revokes API access and stops all order processing.

Is my data secure?

All data is transmitted over TLS 1.3 and payments are processed by Stripe. Your WooCommerce consumer key and secret are stored with database encryption-at-rest and are never logged in plaintext. You can revoke access at any time from WooCommerce → Zentria Flow → Disconnect.
